page.layout: One column of running text, with marginal notes in the right margin. A narrow strip of the facing left page at the left edge is not transcribed. Above the text: running head (centre) and page number (right). No catchword or signature.

main_text.l: Dei (quæ nec nobis defutura eft, si ab eo tori
pendeamus[?], & conatus simul noftros fideliter
adjungamus, adjutos, ea omnia & perfecisse & perfu-
lisse[?], quæ nobis aut facienda aut ferenda Deo sic
difpenfante incumbunt: redire mox animi, inc-
alefcere pia æmulatione peftora, & {1}inter medita-
ndum exardefcere ignem; dum erumpant tandem
è plenitudine cordis hæ aut perfimiles voces,

l.i: En me paratum, Domine, obire quod jubes, Jubire

main_text.l: quod imponis. {2}Nubes illa teftium, quæ nos qua-
cunque circumspectamus cingit undique, fuadet
ut omni abjecto ægri animi tumore & gravedine,
peccatíque, quæ ut nos arctè compleEtitur, ita
per Dei gratiam, si ftrenuè conemur, non ægrè
comprimitur importunitate, propofitum nobis sta-
dium fortiter & constanter & patienter decurra-mus.
XXIV. Hortatur Jacobus Apostolus, cap. 5. ad
exhortationis instantiam, exemplo Eliæ, qui import-
unis suis precibus (προσευχῇ προσηύξατο[?])
cœli oftia quasi pro arbitrio obieravit & reseravit.
Quod nequis existimaret Eliæ meritis & sanctitati
debeti potius, quàm Divinæ Promissioni fide-
lium precibus ex fœdere gratiæ factæ; præripit
hanc suspicionem Apostolus in ipso narrationis exo-
rdio, Elias, inquit, homo erat, ὁμοιοπαθὴς
ἡμῖν[?] — verf. 17. Homo erat: non Deus, aut Angelus:
nec de meliore lato, sed ex eadem qua cæ-
teri homines masså effictus. Hic est ergo usus
Exemplorum proprius & perutilis: ast meminisse
interim oportet, Exempla non esse regulam ipsam,
nec regulæ pondus & instar habere: imò esse &
ipsa, siqua dubitandi ratio appareat rectène an
recus facta sint, ad regulam diligenter exigenda. ὑπόδειγμα
λάβετε τῆς κακοπαθείας[?], inquit Jaco-
bus, Jac 5. 10. Ubi nescio an illud ὑπόδειγμα
specialem habeat ἐνέργειαν & vim: Mihi certè
innuere

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "tori" (possibly "toti"); "perfulisse" (last letters unclear); Greek in the parenthesis after "precibus", after "ὁμοιοπαθὴς", and in the line "ὑπόδειγμα ... κακοπαθείας" is hard to read in the scan and is marked [?]. Left-edge strip (neighbouring page) and the word "Dei" at its foot belong to the facing page and are omitted. Marginal notes: "1 Psalm. 39 4." and "2 H.b. 12. 1 &c." as printed; "P/alm." read as Psalm. Printed "Præleƈtio" read as Prælectio (ct ligature).
